identify_affected_packages.expected_solution: PR #8897 in pnpm v10.0.0 changes the lifecycle-script execution policy default to require an explicit allow-list. The change is in `@pnpm/config` (`config/config/src/getOptionsFromRootManifest.ts`), where the default value of the `onlyBuiltDependencies`/lifecycle-script options flips from permissive to allow-list-only. Two sibling packages observe the behavior change in their tests and command flow: (1) `@pnpm/plugin-commands-installation` / `@pnpm/plugin-commands-rebuild` (`exec/plugin-commands-rebuild/test/index.ts` covers the allow-list enforcement during install and rebuild), and (2) the top-level `pnpm` CLI (`pnpm/test/install/global.ts`, `pnpm/test/install/lifecycleScripts.ts`, `pnpm/test/monorepo/index.ts`) which exercises end-to-end lifecycle-script behavior.
evaluation_criteria: Must identify @pnpm/config as the source-of-change package and cite config/config/src/getOptionsFromRootManifest.ts
Must identify the pnpm CLI package and reference at least one of pnpm/test/install/lifecycleScripts.ts, pnpm/test/install/global.ts, or pnpm/test/monorepo/index.ts
Should mention this is a default-value flip — the code path already exists, only the default changes

classify_change_impact.expected_solution: Overall semver bump = **major** (v10.0.0). Although the source code change is small (single field default flipped in `config/config/src/getOptionsFromRootManifest.ts`), the *behavior* change is observable to every existing repo: previously running scripts now require an explicit allow-list and therefore are skipped by default. This is a deliberate breaking change for security hardening. Per-package: `@pnpm/config` = major (default value of public option flips), `@pnpm/plugin-commands-rebuild` and `pnpm` CLI = major because their observable behavior on existing projects changes — install/rebuild no longer runs arbitrary lifecycle scripts unless declared.
evaluation_criteria: Must classify overall semver as `major` and explicitly call this a breaking behavior change despite small code surface
Must classify @pnpm/config as major because the default of a public option changes
Must classify the pnpm CLI as major because end-to-end install/rebuild behavior changes for existing repos
Should explain this is a deliberate security-hardening break — not a bug fix

identify_boundary_violations.expected_solution: Concrete violation sites: (1) `config/config/src/getOptionsFromRootManifest.ts` — the only source change; the default for the lifecycle-script allow-list option flips. Test/coverage updates that show the boundary impact: (2) `exec/plugin-commands-rebuild/test/index.ts` — install-time rebuild now respects allow-list and tests must register expected scripts. (3) `pnpm/test/install/lifecycleScripts.ts` — direct coverage of the new policy: scripts not on the allow-list don't run by default. (4) `pnpm/test/install/global.ts` — global install path also affected. (5) `pnpm/test/monorepo/index.ts` — multi-package workspace install must thread allow-list through every workspace project. PR file count = 6, all clustered around the single config change plus its E2E coverage.
evaluation_criteria: Must cite config/config/src/getOptionsFromRootManifest.ts as the single source-change file
Must cite at least two test files among pnpm/test/install/lifecycleScripts.ts, pnpm/test/install/global.ts, pnpm/test/monorepo/index.ts, and exec/plugin-commands-rebuild/test/index.ts
Must explain why the boundary cuts across config/CLI/exec — the config default flows through multiple consumer paths
Should note the small (6-file) PR scope despite the major semver impact
